title: Warm Smoky Norwegian Potato Dumplings
description: A traditional Norwegian dish featuring fluffy potato dumplings infused with the deep flavor of hot smoked paprika, perfect for a cold winter's night. This ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Boil the potatoes until they are tender, then drain and let cool.
Grate the cooled potatoes using a box grater or food processor.
In a large bowl, combine the grated potatoes, flour, hot smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Mix the ingredients together until they are well combined.
Add the eggs to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it is smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the dumplings for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
While the dumplings are cooking, melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the dumplings are done, remove them from the water with a slotted spoon and toss them in the melted butter to coat.
Sprinkle the chopped chives over the top of the dumplings and serve hot.
